applies_to: Wilo CCe switch boxes on HVAC circulation pump systems with electronically controlled pumps, fitted with the BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP extension module.
summary: Wilo's CC-family switch boxes run multi-pump systems and connect to a BMS through a plug-in BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP extension module, acting as a BACnet server. The CCe HVAC list covers on/off, setpoints, pump modes, pump state bits, running hours, error bits and an alarm history. Fieldbus write access is governed by a bus command timer that must be refreshed every five minutes.
notes: Taken from the CCe HVAC table in Wilo's CC BACnet supplement (English part, pp64-67). Wilo prints a 'BACnet ID' beside an explicit object type (AV, BV, MSV); the ID is used here as the object instance. The doc never says 'instance' in words, so confirm one point on the device.

Where Wilo prints several IDs against one name (pump state, error state and other bitmaps), each ID is its own Binary Value for the element printed beside it; the element is shown in brackets after the name. Elements printed as '-' or '---' are unused and left out (2 here).
Analog values with several units listed (bar, m, K, °C, psi...) report in the unit of the active control mode.
The 'Added' column gives the list version each object appeared in (31.000, 31.100); older switch box software may lack some objects.
System control (BV 1122-1127) holds Extern off, pump change, add/remove pump and the regulator source (analog or fieldbus); with fieldbus regulator operation the BMS writes the value in % to AV 1139.

integration.summary: Map Drives on/off (BV 224) as the start/stop command and Set point 1 (AV 1072) as the setpoint. For fieldbus control, write Set to the Bus command timer (MV 208) and repeat it within five minutes. Read the collective run and fault signals (BV 976/977) and the Error state bits for alarms; acknowledge with BV 1985.

integration.enable: The Bus command timer (MV 208) decides who may change settings. Manual: HMI and fieldbus both write, last value wins. Off: HMI locked, fieldbus only. Set: HMI locked and a 5-minute timer starts (state reads Active).
integration.heartbeat: With the Bus command timer in Set mode, Set must be written again at least every five minutes. If it lapses the state changes to Reset, the HMI gets access back and the fieldbus is locked until Set is written again.
setup: Menu 4.3.8.3 sets the BACnet device name (default WILO CC BAC) and device object ID (0-4194303, default 22).
BACnet IP module: default IP 192.168.0.5, mask 255.255.255.0, gateway 0.0.0.0.
BACnet MS/TP module: baud 9600, 19.2k, 38.4k or 76.8k; node address 0-127 (default 2); max master default 10; max info frames 1-127.
The BACnet extension needs a switch box software update by Wilo service.
gotchas: In Bus command timer Off mode the HMI stays locked; if the fieldbus fails there is no access until it recovers.
Active setpoint value (AV 416) is read-only in dp-v and dT-v control modes.
Alarm history: write the index to AV 1990, then read the code, year, month/day and time objects. Month/day and time are packed (value mod 100 and value / 100).
